description: Run a piece of work as an ORCHESTRATOR of sub-agents instead of doing it all inline: decompose the task, dispatch scoped sub-agents — each on the cheapest model that can do its piece well — then verify and synthesize their results. The work to perform is whatever is passed as the skill's argument (`/orchestrate <work>`). Also use whenever the user asks to "orchestrate", "coordinate agents", "fan out", "parallelize", or "delegate" a task, or hands over a large multi-part job — a repo-wide audit or migration, broad research, a review from several angles, anything whose parts can proceed independently.
